question: Are the straight segments reported for GRWL viewer features 13164 and 28938 present in the producer source, introduced in GeoParquet conversion, or introduced in PMTiles/rendering?
method: Resolve viewer feature identity to source_row, producer OBJECTID and repeated producer ID without assuming these are interchangeable.
Verify original archive and prepared asset hashes before comparison.
Compare every original SHP part and float64 vertex for the two records with GeoParquet; separately preserve multipart boundaries.

List the longest consecutive source segments and all near-horizontal segments >=1000 geodesic metres (absolute latitude delta <=1e-6 degrees), preserving endpoints and part/vertex indexes. These are diagnostics, not validity criteria.
Decode actual PMTiles at the affected locations across zooms 0 through 10; compare segments to original geometry and distinguish clipping, simplification, multipart joins and antimeridian behavior.

If artifacts originate in our conversion or renderer, preserve the failing evidence and add a regression before fixing. If present upstream, document exact source evidence without silently altering authoritative geometry.
limits: Offline retained data only; no GEE jobs, uploads or replacement scientific data.
Do not alter the existing immutable releases or historical passing checks.
The user-provided IDs define the sample; no inference that other geometries are problem-free.

ownership.parent: Original-source/GeoParquet trace, script/evidence/docs, conclusions and commits
